market.question: Will GTA 6 cost $100+?
market.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the standard edition of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) launches at $100.00 or more. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This market will resolve based on the pre-tax launch price in USD of the standard edition of GTA 6 on Xbox or PlayStation as listed on the Microsoft Store or PlayStation Store on the first official day of its release in the United States.

If the price differs between the Microsoft and PlayStation stores, this market will resolve according to the lower price.

This market will resolve based on the lowest price version that includes the full standard game with no DLC, etc.

The primary resolution source for this market will be the Microsoft Store/PlayStation Store, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

- Both sides have made territorial concessions: Ukraine accepts not recapturing lost territory; Russia abandoned goals to conquer Zaporizhzhia and Kherson[3]

market.question: Will bitcoin hit $1m before GTA VI?
market.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any Binance 1 minute candle for Bitcoin (BTCUSDT) has a final "High" price of $1,000,000 or higher before Grand Theft Auto VI is officially released in the US. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If neither occurs by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source for the release of GTA VI is official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

The resolution source for Bitcoin is Binance, specifically the BTCUSDT "High" prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/BTC_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" for one-minute candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance BTCUSDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.

Bitcoin is trading around $76,784-$77,000 as of early February 2026, with short-term AI predictions ranging from $72,500 to $82,500 by February 28, showing modest downside or slight upside potential.[4] No official GTA VI release date has been announced by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive; past delays suggest a likely 2026 launch, potentially Fall, but nothing confirmed before July 31, 2026 deadline. Market price sits at 50/50, reflecting high uncertainty with 178 days remaining and $100k+ liquidity.

### 2. Key Factors
- **Bitcoin Price Trajectory**: Requires BTC to hit $1M high on Binance BTCUSDT 1m candle first. Current ~$77k needs ~13x growth in <6 months; post-halving bull cycles historically peak 12-18 months after (April 2024 halving implies peak mid-2025, already passed without $1M).[1][2]
- **GTA VI Release Timing**: Official US public availability (purchase/download) per Rockstar/Take-Two; console exclusives count. Announced 2025, delayed from 2024—likely 2026, but no firm date; if before BTC $1M, resolves No.[user query]
- **Market Deadline**: Neither event by July 31, 2026 ET resolves 50-50, creating a hedge against prolonged delay in either.
- **External Catalysts**: Institutional adoption (e.g., ETFs, treasuries), macro shifts (rate cuts, inflation), regulation; counter: volatility, recessions.[1][2]

### 3. Base Rate Analysis
Bitcoin has never achieved 13x growth in 6 months from $77k levels; historical bull peaks post-halving: 2013 (~100x yearly), 2017 (~20x), 2021 (~6x from cycle low)—diminishing returns as market cap grows ($1M implies ~$20T cap, rivaling gold).[1][2][3] No precedent for $1M by mid-2026; 2026 forecasts cluster $100k-$230k avg, max ~$150k.[1][2] GTA VI base rate: Rockstar titles (GTA V 2013) launch on schedule post-announce, but VI delayed multiple times, increasing odds of slipping past July.[user query]

**Mispriced toward No (true prob ~30-40% Yes).** 50/50 overvalues Yes given BTC forecasts maxing $150k-$230k in 2026 (Changelly, Coinpedia) vs. $1M requiring unprecedented 60%+ CAGR from here—math "nearly impossible" per Nasdaq analysis (137% CAGR if dips to $75k).[1][2][3] Cathie Wood/Tom Lee $1M calls are 2030+, not 2026; short-term AI/models predict <$100k Feb 2026.[1][4] GTA VI uncertainty favors No if game launches first (probable Fall 2026 pre-deadline). 50-50 cliff hedges, but BTC path too steep vs. historical base rates.

- **BTC Crash**: Dips below $75k kills $1M path (137% CAGR needed).[3][4]

**BUY**

75%
